# `pi_station_auto_connect`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run the device network helper in automatic mode to reconnect the station network.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit and 32-bit builds) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcd980, ns_net::pi_station_auto @0x6fcc90 (64-bit build) |

Reads no parameters. Runs the configured network helper script with the argument auto, synchronously, and treats the call as failed if its output contains the substring error (case-insensitive). Empty output counts as success. Because it can change the station or network connection, it may interrupt the caller own connection. No ssid, password or timeout is requested, and none is applied on the RPC side. What the helper actually does, and any resulting events, are unresolved.

Side effects: Executes the network helper via a shell pipe, synchronously; can change Wi-Fi/station connectivity and drop the current connection. No RPC-side timeout. Tier C is INFERRED from the reconnect command the helper runs; the helper script's own behaviour is unresolved.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"pi_station_auto_connect"`. [READ] |
| `params` | any | no | - | Not read. Omission, null, object, scalar and array all take the same path. Clients SHOULD omit it. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 207 | Helper output contains the substring error (case-insensitive); if the helper cannot be run the thread-local code is forwarded instead (exact codes unresolved) | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":181,"method":"pi_station_auto_connect"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"pi_station_auto_connect","result":0,"code":0,"id":181}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"pi_station_auto_connect","error":"fail to operate","code":207,"id":182}
```
